hero.title: Making Legal Help Accessible, Trustworthy, and Human
hero.description: Huqouq was built to close the gap between people who need legal help and the qualified professionals ready to provide it — starting in the UAE, with trust at the center of everything we do.

story.title: Why We Started Huqouq
story.paragraph1: It started with a simple frustration: too many people we knew — friends, family, people in our own community — struggled to find a lawyer they could trust. Not because good lawyers didn't exist, but because there was no clear, honest way to find them.
story.paragraph2: We saw lawyers doing excellent work with no easy way to reach the clients who needed them. And we saw people facing real legal challenges, unsure where to even begin.
story.paragraph3: So we built Huqouq — not as another directory, but as a platform where trust comes first. Every lawyer reviewed. Every case considered with care. Every connection built to last beyond a single transaction.
story.paragraph4: This is just the beginning. We're proud to start here, in the UAE, and we're building Huqouq to grow with the trust of every person who uses it.

whyHuqouq.title: Why We Built Huqouq
whyHuqouq.paragraph1: Finding the right lawyer shouldn't be confusing, slow, or opaque. Too often, people facing real legal challenges don't know where to start — and qualified lawyers struggle to reach the clients who need them most.
whyHuqouq.paragraph2: Huqouq was created to solve this directly: a platform where every lawyer is verified before they can practice on it, every case is reviewed before it's published, and every connection is built on transparency — from pricing to communication to resolution.
whyHuqouq.paragraph3: We're proud to launch first in the United Arab Emirates, building a platform rooted in the standards, language, and trust this region deserves.

verification.question: How are lawyers verified?
verification.answer: Every lawyer on HUQOUQ undergoes a manual review of their credentials before receiving a Verified badge. Our team checks bar registration, professional licence, and identification documents. Lawyers only become visible to clients after this process is complete — there are no unverified profiles on the platform.

privacy.question: Is my information private?
privacy.answer: Yes. Your personal contact details — phone number, email, and address — are never shared with any lawyer until you explicitly choose to hire them. Before that point, communication happens through our encrypted in-platform messaging system.

cost.question: What does it cost?
cost.answer: Posting a case and browsing lawyer profiles is free for clients. Lawyers set their own pricing per case or consultation. There are no hidden platform fees charged to clients — any service fees are transparently disclosed before you confirm a hire.

emergency.question: How does the Emergency service work?
emergency.answer: Our Emergency Legal Assistance feature surfaces lawyers who have opted in to urgent availability. When you submit an emergency case, it is immediately matched to available lawyers — typically resulting in contact within minutes. This service is available around the clock.

cancel.question: Can I cancel or close a case anytime?
cancel.answer: Yes. You can withdraw or close your case at any point before confirming a hire. Once a lawyer has been hired and work has commenced, standard terms apply — but our support team is always available to mediate any disputes fairly and promptly.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.introduction: HUQUQ ("we," "us," or "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our platform.

informationWeCollect.title: Information We Collect
informationWeCollect.content: We collect information you provide during registration, including your name, email, phone number, and professional credentials. We also collect usage data and device information to improve your experience.

howWeUseYourInformation.title: How We Use Your Information
howWeUseYourInformation.content: Your information is used to verify your identity and professional credentials, match you with relevant legal services, process payments, and communicate updates about your cases. We use analytics to improve our platform and service quality.

dataSharingAndThirdParties.title: Data Sharing & Third Parties
dataSharingAndThirdParties.content: Information is shared only with third parties necessary for service delivery, such as payment processors, cloud storage providers, and other service providers. All third parties are bound by confidentiality agreements and comply with data protection standards.

yourRights.title: Your Rights
yourRights.content: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information. To exercise these rights, contact us via the form below. We will respond to requests within 30 days.

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
dataSecurity.content: We employ industry-standard encryption and security measures to protect your data. While we strive for maximum security, no online platform is entirely immune to breaches.

contactForPrivacyConcerns.title: Contact for Privacy Concerns
contactForPrivacyConcerns.content: If you have concerns about how we handle your data or to exercise your privacy rights, please contact us through our privacy inquiry form or email us directly at the address provided.

policyUpdates.title: Policy Updates
policyUpdates.content: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. We will notify you of significant changes via email or platform notifications.
